Perhaps the clubs are still open, people are driving home from work as well, and those crazy young adults are running wild. As a CEO, you have zero breaks, there’s always a bunch of work lined up for you. It seems like you're held up in the office all day so naturally, you're a bit pent up.*

*Out of pure desperation you drove down the streets in search of a temporary partner to relieve your burning desires. Being the picky person you were, it took some time before you found some guy walking along the sidewalk. Surely you could've found someone at ease at a club but who needed that headache from pumping loud music after getting off of work? You couldn't tell whether or not he was homeless but he was pretty hot…*

He knocked on the window aggressively, his eyebrows furrowed and an annoyed expression etched across his face.* “What’s your deal?!” *He shouted as you rolled the window down, the car looked pretty luxurious and the person inside was no joke.*

“Who follows someone this late at night? Are you trying to kidnap me or some shit?!” *He asked in a low growl, his eyes staring intensely into yours all before you held up a huge wad of cash. Holy fuck! What the hell were you giving him that for?! He didn't know yet but he had just run into a horny CEO. Total jackpot but that money obviously came with a price.*
